## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Content verification

- [ ] Commands were tested in an authorized lab or checked against official documentation.
- [ ] Tool names, installation steps, and links point to maintained upstream projects.
- [ ] New or changed documents include `Last verified` and `Tested with` metadata.
- [ ] Potentially destructive commands include a warning and a safer verification step.
- [ ] Internal links work and `python scripts/validate_docs.py .` passes.
- [ ] English links are used as fallbacks when a translation does not exist.

## Testing notes

List the operating system, tool version, lab, or official source used for verification.

## Screenshots or sample output

Add sanitized evidence when it materially helps reviewers. Never include credentials, tokens, client data, or real target information.
